arenas.doc: M2-BPR-07: per-encounter battle arenas (docs/kb/tech/battle_presentation.md, Arenas). BattleArena moves the children of an arena's scene into the battle scene, each replacing the node of the same name (WorldEnvironment, Sun, Arena; extra lights are added). An encounter with no row fights on the sandbox's own arena (the sandbox and every capture fixture). Greybox scenes; env-art owns the final kits.
